description: Unit tests for the SocketBIOAdapter class, testing synchronous and asynchronous socket I/O, error handling, and self-deletion during callbacks.

classes.name: SocketBIOAdapterTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for SocketBIOAdapter, supporting parameterized tests for read support.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, enabling read-if-ready support based on test parameter.

methods.name: MakeTestSocket
methods.description: Creates and connects a mock StreamSocket for testing.

methods.name: set_reset_on_write_ready
methods.description: Sets a pointer to a SocketBIOAdapter to be reset during tests.

methods.name: ExpectReadError
methods.description: Verifies that BIO_read fails with a specific error and error is correctly mapped.

methods.name: ExpectBlockingRead
methods.description: Checks that BIO_read returns a retryable error and BIO_should_read is true.

methods.name: ExpectWriteError
methods.description: Verifies that BIO_write fails with a specific error and error is correctly mapped.

methods.name: ExpectBlockingWrite
methods.description: Checks that BIO_write returns a retryable error and BIO_should_write is true.

methods.name: WaitForReadReady
methods.description: Runs the message loop until OnReadReady is called.

methods.name: WaitForWriteReady
methods.description: Runs the message loop until OnWriteReady is called, optionally resuming a paused socket.

methods.name: WaitForBothReady
methods.description: Runs until both OnReadReady and OnWriteReady are called.

methods.name: OnReadReady
methods.description: Delegate callback invoked when socket is ready for reading.

methods.name: OnWriteReady
methods.description: Delegate callback invoked when socket is ready for writing; may reset adapter.
